description.en: Selects the engine's light setting by name, for both of its light slots (0 and 1). The skill scene script sets "sky" (its DEFAULT_LIGHT) when it ends without a field map.

true once set.
null if the script system is not ready or no argument is given.

examples.case: Back to the default light (real usage, from ie4_ev_sub_skl.nut)
